_comment: The suite's apps: the one list scripts/deploy-apps.sh builds and registers, scripts/configure.sh routes
(each app on its own sub-domain: <host>.<PUTER_DOMAIN>), and the App Center, the apps button and the Admin
console list. Add an app here and run scripts/deploy-apps.sh <name>; turn one off for everyone in Admin.
name: Puter's app name (Puter's standard names show on the desktop out of the box). source: a folder of
~/everything/src, or suite:<folder> for one in this project. build: extra build settings; ${...} are filled
in from the suite's settings (scripts/lib/suite.sh). adminOnly: listed only for administrators. opens: the
file types it opens on a double-click in Files or on the desktop, ahead of Puter's own apps.
